_comment: Every non-noun line the app speaks. Nouns come from vocab.json. Keys map 1:1 to audio files at assets/audio/vo/{en|zh}/{key with dots as slashes}.mp3. Copy is final — record verbatim.

matching.color.zh: 把一样颜色的放在一起。
matching.color.pinyin: bǎ yí yàng yán sè de fàng zài yì qǐ.

matching.shape.zh: 把一样形状的放在一起。
matching.shape.pinyin: bǎ yí yàng xíng zhuàng de fàng zài yì qǐ.

matching.category.en: Put the ones that go together, together.
matching.category.pinyin: bǎ shì yí lèi de fàng zài yì qǐ.

matching.size.zh: 把一样大小的放在一起。
matching.size.pinyin: bǎ yí yàng dà xiǎo de fàng zài yì qǐ.

counting.ask.en: Can you give him this many?
counting.ask.pinyin: nǐ néng gěi tā zhè me duō ma?

comparing.order_small_big.en: Line them up, small to big.
comparing.order_small_big.pinyin: cóng xiǎo dào dà pái hǎo duì.

shapes.intro.en: Every shape has its own home.
shapes.intro.zh: 每个形状都有自己的家。
shapes.intro.pinyin: měi gè xíng zhuàng dōu yǒu zì jǐ de jiā.

shapes.sort.en: Put each shape in its own hole.
shapes.sort.zh: 把每个形状放进它自己的洞里。
shapes.sort.pinyin: bǎ měi gè xíng zhuàng fàng jìn tā zì jǐ de dòng lǐ.

spotsame.intro.en: Which one looks exactly the same?
spotsame.intro.pinyin: nǎ yí gè hé tā yì mú yí yàng?

puzzle.intro.en: A piece is missing. Which one fits?
puzzle.intro.pinyin: shǎo le yí kuài. nǎ yí kuài hé shì?

daynight.intro.en: Some things happen in the day, some at night.
daynight.intro.zh: 有些事在白天，有些事在晚上。
daynight.intro.pinyin: yǒu xiē shì zài bái tiān, yǒu xiē shì zài wǎn shang.

daynight.sort.en: Put each one where it belongs.
daynight.sort.zh: 把每个放到它该去的地方。
daynight.sort.pinyin: bǎ měi gè fàng dào tā gāi qù de dì fang.

daynight.either.en: This one can be either! You choose.
daynight.either.pinyin: zhè ge dōu kě yǐ! nǐ lái xuǎn.

floatsink.intro.en: Drop something in and see what happens.
floatsink.intro.zh: 放一个进去，看看会怎么样。
floatsink.intro.pinyin: fàng yí gè jìn qù, kàn kan huì zěn me yàng.

whatisit.intro.en: What do you think it is?
whatisit.intro.pinyin: nǐ cāi zhè shì shén me?

pattern.intro.en: Look at the order they go in.
pattern.intro.pinyin: kàn kan tā men pái de guī lǜ.

pattern.whatnext.pinyin: jiē xià lái shì shén me?

mirror.intro.pinyin: ràng liǎng biān yì mú yí yàng.

game.candles.en: Put this many candles on the cake.
game.candles.zh: 在蛋糕上插这么多蜡烛。
game.candles.pinyin: zài dàn gāo shang chā zhè me duō là zhú.

game.cookies.en: Give your friend this many cookies.
game.cookies.pinyin: gěi xiǎo péng you zhè me duō bǐng gān.

game.seeds.en: Plant this many in the garden.
game.seeds.pinyin: zài huā yuán lǐ zhòng zhè me duō.

game.bus.en: Help this many friends onto the bus.
game.bus.pinyin: ràng zhè me duō xiǎo péng you shàng chē.

game.tidy.en: Let's put everything where it belongs.
game.tidy.pinyin: wǒ men bǎ dōng xi fàng huí jiā.

game.weather.en: What do we need for each kind of day?
game.weather.pinyin: měi zhǒng tiān qì yào dài shén me?

game.feelings.pinyin: nǎ gè biǎo qíng hé tā yí yàng?

game.socks.pinyin: zhǎo chū yí yàng de nà gè.

game.lantern.en: Find the lantern that looks just the same.
game.lantern.zh: 找一个一模一样的灯笼。
game.lantern.pinyin: zhǎo yí gè yì mú yí yàng de dēng long.

game.peekaboo.en: Someone is peeking. Who is it?
game.peekaboo.pinyin: yǒu rén zài tōu kàn. shì shéi ya?

game.shadow.pinyin: zhè shì shéi de yǐng zi?

game.zoom.pinyin: zǐ xì kàn. zhè shì shén me?

game.ladder.en: Build the ladder, short to tall.
game.ladder.pinyin: cóng ǎi dào gāo dā tī zi.

game.stack.pinyin: cóng zuì xiǎo de kāi shǐ dié.

game.growing.en: Line them up, littlest to biggest.
game.growing.pinyin: cóng zuì xiǎo de pái dào zuì dà de.

game.routine.pinyin: wǒ men xiān zuò shén me?

game.beads.pinyin: xià yì kē zhū zi shì shén me?

game.lanterns_next.pinyin: xià yí gè dēng long shì shén me?

game.flowers_next.en: Which one comes next on the path?
game.flowers_next.pinyin: xiǎo lù shang xià yí gè shì shén me?

game.hide.en: Listen. Where is your friend hiding?
game.hide.zh: 听一听。小朋友藏在哪里？
game.hide.pinyin: tīng yi tīng. xiǎo péng you cáng zài nǎ lǐ?

game.treehouse.en: Which floor of the tree house?
game.treehouse.pinyin: zài shù wū de nǎ yì céng?

game.table.pinyin: zhè ge gāi fàng zài nǎ lǐ?

game.memory.en: Turn over two cards. Can you find two the same?
game.memory.zh: 翻开两张牌。找到一样的吗？
game.memory.pinyin: fān kāi liǎng zhāng pái. zhǎo dào yí yàng de ma?

game.wordpairs.en: Turn a card and listen. Find the picture it names.
game.wordpairs.zh: 翻开一张听一听。找到它说的那张图。
game.wordpairs.pinyin: fān kāi yì zhāng tīng yi tīng. zhǎo dào tā shuō de nà zhāng tú.

game.families.en: Turn the cards. Find each baby animal's grown-up.
game.families.zh: 翻开牌。找到动物宝宝的妈妈。
game.families.pinyin: fān kāi pái. zhǎo dào dòng wù bǎo bao de mā ma.

game.shapepairs.en: Turn the cards. Find two with the same shape.
game.shapepairs.zh: 翻开牌。找到形状一样的两张。
game.shapepairs.pinyin: fān kāi pái. zhǎo dào xíng zhuàng yí yàng de liǎng zhāng.

game.snowman.en: Build the snowman, piece by piece.
game.snowman.pinyin: yí kuài yí kuài, bǎ xuě rén duī hǎo.

game.bridge.en: The bridge has a gap. Put the pieces back.
game.bridge.zh: 小桥缺了一段。把它补好。
game.bridge.pinyin: xiǎo qiáo quē le yí duàn. bǎ tā bǔ hǎo.

game.dragonboat.en: Put the dragon boat together: head, body and tail.
game.dragonboat.zh: 拼好龙舟：龙头、船身和龙尾。
game.dragonboat.pinyin: pīn hǎo lóng zhōu: lóng tóu, chuán shēn hé lóng wěi.

game.wings.en: One wing is waiting. Make both wings match.
game.wings.zh: 还差一只翅膀。让两只翅膀一样。
game.wings.pinyin: hái chà yì zhī chì bǎng. ràng liǎng zhī chì bǎng yí yàng.

game.papercut.en: Half the window flower is cut. Finish the other half.
game.papercut.zh: 窗花剪了一半。把另一半剪好。
game.papercut.pinyin: chuāng huā jiǎn le yí bàn. bǎ lìng yí bàn jiǎn hǎo.

game.lake.en: The lake shows everything upside down. Finish the reflection.
game.lake.zh: 湖水把东西倒着照出来。把倒影补好。
game.lake.pinyin: hú shuǐ bǎ dōng xi dào zhe zhào chū lái. bǎ dào yǐng bǔ hǎo.

game.firstwords.pinyin: tīng yi tīng. shì nǎ yí gè?

game.colorwords.en: Listen for the color. Which one is it?
game.colorwords.pinyin: tīng yán sè. shì nǎ yí gè?

game.bodyparts.pinyin: tīng yi tīng. shì nǎ ge bù wèi?

game.numbersoutloud.en: Listen. Which one has this many?
game.numbersoutloud.zh: 听一听。哪一堆是这么多？
game.numbersoutloud.pinyin: tīng yi tīng. nǎ yì duī shì zhè me duō?

feedback.retry2.pinyin: bú shì zhè ge. zài zhǎo zhao!

ui.break.en: Let's take a break. See you soon!
ui.break.zh: 我们休息一下。待会儿见！
ui.break.pinyin: wǒ men xiū xi yí xià. dāi huìr jiàn!

game.traceline.en: Put your finger on the light, and follow the dots.
game.traceline.zh: 把手指放在亮点上，沿着小点走。
game.traceline.pinyin: bǎ shǒu zhǐ fàng zài liàng diǎn shàng, yán zhe xiǎo diǎn zǒu.

game.traceshape.en: Follow the dots all the way around.
game.traceshape.pinyin: yán zhe xiǎo diǎn zǒu yì quān.

game.tracenumber.en: Follow the dots to draw the number.
game.tracenumber.zh: 沿着小点，把数字写出来。
game.tracenumber.pinyin: yán zhe xiǎo diǎn, bǎ shù zì xiě chū lái.

game.tracecharacter.en: Follow the dots. One line at a time.
game.tracecharacter.zh: 沿着小点走，一笔一笔来。
game.tracecharacter.pinyin: yán zhe xiǎo diǎn zǒu, yì bǐ yì bǐ lái.

game.traceletter.en: Follow the dots to draw the letter.
game.traceletter.zh: 沿着小点，把字母写出来。
game.traceletter.pinyin: yán zhe xiǎo diǎn, bǎ zì mǔ xiě chū lái.

game.trace.en: Follow the dots with your finger.
game.trace.pinyin: yòng shǒu zhǐ yán zhe xiǎo diǎn zǒu.

game.echodrums.en: Listen to the sounds. Then tap them back.
game.echodrums.zh: 听一听这些声音。然后照着敲回来。
game.echodrums.pinyin: tīng yi tīng zhè xiē shēng yīn. rán hòu zhào zhe qiāo huí lái.

game.fastslow.en: Some are fast and some are slow. Listen, then tap it back.
game.fastslow.zh: 有的快，有的慢。听一听，然后敲回来。
game.fastslow.pinyin: yǒu de kuài, yǒu de màn. tīng yi tīng, rán hòu qiāo huí lái.

game.highlow.en: A big low sound, a little high sound. Tap them back.
game.highlow.zh: 低低的大声音，高高的小声音。照着敲回来。
game.highlow.pinyin: dī dī de dà shēng yīn, gāo gāo de xiǎo shēng yīn. zhào zhe qiāo huí lái.
